name: FareClaim
contribution: Find the money Translink owes you.
headline: Queenslanders, Translink is probably overcharging your Go Card
summary: FareClaim helps Brisbane commuters scan their Go Card history, detect fixed fare penalties, missed transfers, failed touch-ons, failed touch-offs, and duplicate charges, then prepare the exact details needed for a Translink fare adjustment claim.
body:
You tap on and tap off every day. But card readers break. You rush off the bus and forget. The system glitches and misses your transfer discount. Every time this happens, you get slapped with a fixed fare penalty.

Finding those $35 and $60 leaks on the Go Card website is tedious, so most people let it go. FareClaim lets Queenslanders drop in their Go Card history file, scans recent trips in seconds, finds the exact overcharges, and gives them the dates, routes, and reasons they need to claim money back.

The product is built around a simple flow: upload your travel history, let the app scan for penalties and missed connections, then copy the results into the official Translink adjustment form. It is positioned as an independent tool built by Brisbane commuters and emphasizes that travel data is not stored.
